transformations.description: Uses the published numeric Alicante operator stop code as the stable StopNode suffix and creates one singleton StopPlace with the same suffix for every new code.
Stores published Ida and Vuelta lists as independent directed patterns. No reverse pattern is inferred and closesLoop is false for all six patterns.
Removes one consecutive duplicate occurrence of stop code 3930 from the source-rendered line 01 Vuelta list, preventing a forbidden self-edge while preserving every distinct source stop.
Adds exactly one catalog descriptor and recomputes asset and aggregate SHA-256 values from serialized bytes.

warnings: The supplied map defines a legacy route-family scope, while the available machine-readable textual ordering and coordinates are current 2026 captures. The three route identities and endpoint corridors agree, but this package does not claim a frozen historical timetable snapshot.
Different numeric stop codes remain separate StopNodes and separate singleton StopPlaces even when names match or positions are close.
StopNode.sourceReferences is empty because no genuine OpenStreetMap platform or stop_position evidence was used.
Current numeric stop codes are treated as the Alicante identity key for this new registry. Later components must reuse complete objects exactly when codes match.
